name: CelesTrak Provider Parser Nodes
description: Pure WASM provider-parser flow nodes for CelesTrak ingest (typed contracts 1.0: FlatBuffers only, no JSON and no base64): parse_gp (GP CSV -> OMM + MPE record streams), parse_satcat (SATCAT fixed-width txt or CSV -> CAT), parse_spw (SW-All.csv -> SPW with the 7-day stale-source gate), parse_eop (EOP-All.csv -> $EOP with radians in the _HP fields), parse_socrates (SOCRATES sort CSV -> $CSM). Each method takes the hostcap/http-request HttpResponse, whose CONTEXT is the job celestrak-request sent (ONE size-prefixed $ICN record: endpoint, source tags, dataset, origin, usage terms), computes batch_id = sha256(payload), builds records with the spacedatastandards.org GENERATED C++ code mirroring sdn-server internal/ingest parsing rules and internal/sds builder defaults byte-for-byte, and emits per-schema IngestRequests for hostcap/storage-ingest (source tags, reconcile mode, archive naming keyed by the job's dataset, licence identifier / licence URL / citation, wasm-authored Provenance) plus size-prefixed record streams and the HttpResponse itself as the raw document for archiving. Response validators (etag, last-modified, content-type, date) are read from the lower-cased HEADERS into the provenance. HTTP 304 Not Modified is accepted: the method emits one FlowNotice (Unchanged) on its 'unchanged' port and nothing else, so no batch is stored or announced. A response with no $ICN job is refused (missing-context). No capabilities and no hostcalls: this node performs no I/O.

sequentialJustification.detail: Each method turns one fetch response into its batch frames in one pass; no state survives an invocation, no worker pool and no thread.

methods.description: Parses a CelesTrak GP CSV payload into OMM + MPE record streams with full provenance ingest requests. BATCHING: the response port is single-stream by contract and ENFORCED IN CODE (the compiled flow runtime drains a node's queue port-blind up to 64 frames; maxStreams is declarative): a surplus is refused with error code "batched-input-frames" (graph task modules-guest-nodes-drop-batched-frames).

acceptedTypeSets.description: HttpResponse (HRSP) from hostcap/http-request: STATUS (200 parses, 304 is the unchanged notice, anything else fails the node), HEADERS (etag, last-modified, content-type, date), BODY the payload verbatim, CONTEXT the job celestrak-request sent - ONE size-prefixed $ICN record (ENDPOINT_URL, SOURCE_NAME, PROVIDER_ID, DATASET_ID, LICENSE, LICENSE_URL, CITATION, origin); a response without one is refused (missing-context).

inputPorts.description: One fetch response (its job in CONTEXT).

acceptedTypeSets.description: IngestRequest (INGQ) for hostcap/storage-ingest: SCHEMA OMM.fbs; TAGS PROVIDER_ID / SOURCE_NAME / SOURCE_URL from the job, BATCH_ID sha256 of the payload, CONTENT_KEY_ID public, SOURCE_PEER source:celestrak, LICENSE (the job's licence when it is an identifier of at most 64 bytes, else LicenseRef-CelesTrak-Usage-Policy), LICENSE_URL, CITATION; RECONCILE duplicates; ARCHIVE celestrak/catalog.csv; PROVENANCE (source URL, HTTP status, validators, retrieval time, parser celestrak-gp-wasm v2, payload and normalized SHA-256, counts OMM.fbs + MPE.fbs).
Size-prefixed $OMM record stream ([u32le len][record]).

IngestRequest (INGQ) for hostcap/storage-ingest: SCHEMA MPE.fbs; TAGS PROVIDER_ID / SOURCE_NAME / SOURCE_URL from the job, BATCH_ID sha256 of the payload, CONTENT_KEY_ID public, SOURCE_PEER source:celestrak, LICENSE (the job's licence when it is an identifier of at most 64 bytes, else LicenseRef-CelesTrak-Usage-Policy), LICENSE_URL, CITATION; RECONCILE duplicates; no ARCHIVE and no PROVENANCE (the payload is archived once, with the OMM batch).
Size-prefixed $MPE record stream ([u32le len][record]).
The HttpResponse the batch was made from, forwarded verbatim: its BODY is the payload hostcap/storage-ingest archives under the ARCHIVE naming.

outputPorts.description: Raw document for archiving (once per fetch).

acceptedTypeSets.description: FlowNotice (FNTC) Unchanged on HTTP 304 only: SCHEMA OMM.fbs, PROVIDER_ID, SOURCE_NAME, REASON not-modified, COUNT 1, ITEMS [the source URL]; no meta, records or raw then.

methods.description: Parses CelesTrak EOP-All.csv (DATE,MJD,X,Y,UT1-UTC,LOD,DPSI,DEPS,DX,DY,DAT,DATA_TYPE) into an $EOP record stream: arcsecond columns to radians in the authoritative double-precision _HP fields with float32 copies, DAT to TAI_MINUS_UTC_SECONDS, DATA_TYPE O/P, SERIES FINALS2000A, IAU_2000A, DATA_SET_EPOCH from Last-Modified; enforces the 7-day stale-source gate on the newest OBSERVED row; reconcile "current" because each fetch is the whole history and supersedes the previous snapshot. methods.description: Parses one CelesTrak SOCRATES sort file (sort-minRange.csv or sort-maxProb.csv; NORAD_CAT_ID_1,OBJECT_NAME_1,DSE_1,NORAD_CAT_ID_2,OBJECT_NAME_2,DSE_2,TCA,TCA_RANGE,TCA_RELATIVE_SPEED,MAX_PROB,DILUTION, alternates accepted) into a $CSM record stream: nested CAT identities (NORAD_CAT_ID, OBJECT_NAME with the ' [+]' status suffix split into OPS_STATUS_CODE), DSE_1/DSE_2, TCA as unix seconds with the published fraction, TCA_RANGE km, TCA_RELATIVE_SPEED km/s, MAX_PROB, DILUTION; reconcile "current" because each file is a snapshot of the current conjunction list. BATCHING: the response port is single-stream by contract and ENFORCED IN CODE (the compiled flow runtime drains a node's queue port-blind up to 64 frames; maxStreams is declarative): a surplus is refused with error code "batched-input-frames" (graph task modules-guest-nodes-drop-batched-frames).
